points.description: States that each pack of strawberry gum cost $2 (the final answer). Working must be mathematically valid throughout, e.g. green apple = $1, so 2s + 2 + 1 = 7 gives s = 2. Equivalent methods and wording earn the mark. Any invalid step or wrong final value earns no mark.

rubric.notes: The question has one answer to find, so the scheme is a single all-or-nothing point. Full marks require a correct, valid derivation ending in $2 per strawberry pack. Any wrong step or wrong final value earns zero, as the model answer's rule specifies, so there is no partial credit.
